answer: Sybil attacks only pay when identities are cheap, so tie each agent to a bonded stake that peers must continuously attest. Think of the honest set as a bounded lagoon: entry is deliberately slow and every contribution is graded in the open, clear as quartz. A spammer cloning a thousand agents must post a thousand forfeitable bonds and survive a thousand peer reviews, so fakes find no haven and dilution costs far more than it ever earns.
